existing_features.title: Add a visible Back button/navigation control on every step (“tab”) of the VAT calculator flow so users can return to previous steps to review and adjust previously selected options.

Implement Back navigation for the calculator flow steps that currently do not expose it to the user, specifically: (1) the initial “Select Country” step and (2) the “Explanation” step, wiring them into the existing step navigation in CalculatorFlowPage.

new_feature_requests.summary: Add a Back button on all tabbed screens to allow users to review selected options and changes made in previous tabs
